evidence: The films were characterized by means of x-ray diffraction, Rutherford backscattering spectrometry, nuclear reaction analysis, scanning electron microscopy, and by optical and electrical measurements. ... Crystal structure and orientation of the films were determined by a Philips MPD 1880 powder diffractometer ... Surface morphologies and cross sections of the films were examined by a Zeiss DSM 962 scanning electron microscope ... The electrical properties were examined by the Hall effect measurements ... Thicknesses and refractive indexes of the films were evaluated by fitting transmittance spectra ... The films were cooled to about 250~ under nitrogen flow before removing from the reactor. ... The electrical properties were examined by the Hall effect measurements using the van der Pauw geometry ... The resistivities of the highly transparent films were in the order of 3  10 -3 ~l-cm.
